import.title: Referee course results
import.uploadLabel: Select CSV file with referee course results
import.intro: Upload a CSV file with referee course results. Each import then goes through a review step — the license level is set per row and any deviating master data is corrected.
import.disabled: CSV import is switched off. Courses and results are recorded in Saisonmanager. Open imports below can still be edited and submitted.
import.allClosed: No open imports. Completed ones can be shown with the checkbox above.

detail.progress: {{ total }} records • {{ pending }} open • {{ applied }} applied
detail.reviewHint: Choose the license level and, if needed, the correct master data for each record. You can submit a clarified row right away with “Submit” in that row, or all open rows at once with the button below. Only after submitting are the records presented for approval (if the state association has enabled its review process).
detail.name: Name:
detail.cancelContent: Really cancel this import? All uploaded rows and pre-entries will be discarded.
detail.missingLevels: The license level is still missing for {{ count }} records.
detail.submittedInfo: Import submitted. Records without correction are applied directly. Records with corrections wait — provided the state association has enabled the control process — for approval by the state association's RSK.
detail.skippedSummary: {{ count }} rows skipped because they are already applied or still open in an earlier import
detail.deferHint: Rows with an open question can be deferred — they stay behind while the others are submitted, and can be added later or discarded.
detail.discardContent: Discard {{ row }} for good? The row will not be imported. Nothing has been written to the referee yet.
detail.allDeferred: All open rows are deferred — there is nothing to submit.
detail.partiallySubmittedInfo: Partially submitted. {{ count }} row(s) are still open: submit them one by one or all at once, deferred ones once clarified, or discard them. The import is complete after that.
detail.nothingOpen: No open row left — every row has been submitted or discarded. The import can be cancelled.
detail.clubMatchAliasBroken: name-list entry points to no club

review.title: Referee course results: approval
review.intro: Records with corrected or newly created master data that your state association's control process has submitted for approval. You can adjust the master data directly — the correction is applied to the referee record with "Approve". License level and validity are fixed and are already set immediately.
review.summary: License no.: {{ licenseNumber }} • License level: {{ level }} • valid until {{ validUntil }}
review.clubUnavailable: Set: {{ club }}. Club list unavailable, selection disabled.

notifications.loadImportsError: The list of imports could not be loaded
notifications.uploadCsvUnprocessable: CSV content could not be processed.
notifications.licenseLevelsLoadError: License levels could not be loaded — submitting is only possible after a reload.
notifications.licenseLevelSaveFailedForRow: License level could not be saved for {{ row }}
notifications.loadPendingError: Open cases could not be loaded
notifications.loadClubsError: Could not load the list of clubs. The club selection stays disabled.
notifications.partiallySubmitted: Import partially submitted — the deferred rows are still open
notifications.rowBusy: A change is still running for {{ row }} — please wait a moment.

edit.licenseLevelsHint: All levels the course can award (F course: L2 and L1). Without a selection the course awards no license, e.g. a refresher.
edit.partnersHint: For joint courses: the RSK of these associations see and co-manage the course.
edit.prerequisitesPlaceholder: e.g. online module attended, G course passed
edit.onlineUrlHint: Never public, only shown to registered participants.
edit.modeNone: Announcement only, no registration (e.g. open online module)
edit.public: Show on the public course page
edit.minAge: Minimum age on the first course day
edit.suggestDeadlines: Suggest deadlines (14 and 7 days before the course)
edit.feeError: Please enter amounts as numbers, e.g. 25 or 12.50.
edit.feeOnlyOnLicense: Fee only if a license is granted
edit.billStateAssociation: Invoice the state association instead of the club

fields.title: Additional registration fields
fields.intro: Additional questions asked during registration. Name, date of birth, e-mail, club and desired license are always asked.
fields.label: Question
fields.lockedHint: There are registrations already: type, choices and required cannot be changed.
fields.healthHint: Please do not ask for health data until this is clarified (special category under Art. 9 GDPR).

templates.title: Field templates
templates.intro: Additional fields every new course of the state association takes over. Existing courses do not change.

courseDetail.waitlisted: The course is full, the person is on the waiting list.
